## Where AI adoption remains low

Barriers to adoption vary but concerns around cost and output quality remain the top reasons for creatives hesitant to use AI in their work.

## Choosing is the hard part now.

The field keeps growing, but what people actually use stays narrow. Most projects run on the same short list, although the options are rapidly expanding and improving.

## Three distinct phases where AI fuels creative workflows.

Ideation, mockup and refinement. Here’s where AI enters and what creatives protect, mapped against the Human Creativity Benchmark.

## Creatives adopting AI are earning more than ever.

AI raised the bar for creativity. Taste, perspective, judgment, and direction became more valuable. And the people learning how to pair those skills with AI are changing everything.

### Three years ago, the story was that AI would replace creatives. That’s not what’s happening.

We surveyed 150k+ creative professionals, and combined this with real marketplace data from Contra. AI adoption is up to over 70% and creatives are earning in entirely new categories. It’s an incredible time for creativity.
